init.title: Memory settings
init.description:
Service-level memory shared by all conversation agents in this entry.

**Speed:** memory off = shortest prompt and fastest reply. Voice control rarely needs it.

Memory panel: `AI Assist Memory` (`/ai-subscription-assist-memory`)

Assist chat commands: `/memory help`, `/memory status`, `/remember <text>`, `/memories <query>`, `/forget <id>`, `/new`.

data_description.memory_enabled: Master switch for long-term memory and slash memory commands.
data_description.memory_auto_write: Capture explicit phrases like 'remember that ...' into per-user memory.
data_description.memory_auto_recall: Appends matching memories to the system prompt — longer prompt, slower reply.
data_description.memory_resume_enabled: Persist recent transcript context so Assist can continue after dialog reopen.
data_description.memory_ttl_days: Automatically expire memories older than this many days.
data_description.memory_max_items_per_scope: Cap memory items for each scope (shared and each user).
data_description.memory_recall_top_k: How many memories may be injected per turn. Fewer = faster.
data_description.memory_resume_max_messages: Maximum number of user/assistant messages kept for resumable context.

abort.entry_not_loaded: Cannot add things while the configuration is disabled.

advanced.title: Model and limits
advanced.description:
Model choice drives speed.

- **Haiku** – fastest, cheapest, weakest on complex commands
- **Sonnet** – balanced
- **Opus** – most accurate, slowest

Keep the token limit low (2000–3000) so the model finishes sooner.

data_description.max_tokens: Upper bound on reply length. Lower = faster. 2000–3000 is plenty for voice control.
data_description.temperature: 0 = predictable and repeatable (recommended for home control), 1 = creative.

init.description:
Model and tool access for this agent.

**Speed:** every enabled tool lengthens the prompt and slows the reply. For home control, **Control Home Assistant = assist** is usually all you need.
History/charts: enable `get_history`, `get_logbook`, `get_statistics` (slower).
Memory is configured at integration level (Integration → Configure).

data_description.enabled_tools: Each enabled tool adds to the prompt and to response time. Enable only what you need.
data_description.llm_hass_api: "assist" lets the agent control entities exposed to Assist. Without it the agent can only talk.
data_description.prompt: A shorter prompt means a faster reply. Templates are supported.
data_description.recommended: On: sensible defaults. Turn off to pick model, token limit and thinking yourself.
data_description.yolo_mode: Disables exposure safeguards and unlocks dashboard/automation edits and log access. Trusted agents only.

init.title: Basic settings

data_description.thinking_budget: Legacy models only. 0 = no thinking (fastest). 1024+ enables extended thinking and clearly slows replies.
data_description.thinking_effort: How much the model thinks before answering. `none`/`low` is fastest and enough for home commands. `medium`/`high` add seconds.
data_description.user_location: Localize search results to your home location.
data_description.web_search: Lets the model fetch current information. Each search adds several seconds.
data_description.web_search_max_uses: Hard cap per response. Keep it at 1–2.

model.title: Thinking and web search
model.description:
These options have the biggest impact on response time.

For voice control: **Thinking effort = low** (or none) and **web search off**, unless the agent should answer questions about the world.
